title: Hono Migration
content:
Switching from Hono to Photon takes less than 5 minutes. Photon provides 100% API compatibility with Hono, making it a drop-in replacement with additional optimizations and enterprise features.

Drop-in Replacement

Simply change your imports and initialization:

// From Hono
import { Hono } from 'hono'
const app = new Hono()

// To Photon
import { Photon } from '@gravito/photon'
const app = new Photon()

API Compatibility

  • 100% API Compatible: All Hono APIs work without changes.
  • Middleware: Identical signature and behavior.
  • Additional Features: Photon includes enterprise middleware like binary handling, JWT utilities, and Bun-specific adapters.
